item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://mit-cdfg.github.io/Survey-AI-for-3D-modeling-Robotics/#view-stats","version_id":"08b1c2cdebb5796d7332d57e8928784a621aec9f82db91448016eaa53ea51fe5","decision":"accept","reason":"This is fresh, directly relevant synthesis of 3D modeling, parametric CAD, and supporting robotics evidence, with quotable passages and a stated review scope of 1,646 public posts across 707 cases. Its central credibility limitation is explicit: only 132 cases have runnable code, so most cited capabilities are demonstrations or vendor reports rather than independently reproduced results; the survey appropriately distinguishes editable outputs and benchmark scores from untested tolerances, manufacturability, and withheld-condition transfer. It adds a useful cross-claim perspective that reported performance depends on the model-plus-tool harness, while its underlying repeated coverage should not be treated as independent corroboration of the same vendor announcement.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
